newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse to trade despite Deng funeral.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse to trade despite Deng funeral.

text.p: The Shanghai Stock Exchange will trade normally on Tuesday despite the funeral of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, an exchange spokesman said on Monday.
Beijing has announced that the funeral will start at 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday.
The Shanghai Metal Exchange will cancel trading sessions between 9:45 a.m. and 10:55 (0145 GMT and 0255 GMT), an exchange statement said.
China's currency markets, the foreign exchange and Chinese yuan interbank markets based in Shanghai, have yet to make a decision, exchange officials said.
